description: NaGaTe₂ is Chalcopyrite structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42d space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent Te²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaTe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaTe₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent GaTe₄ tetrahedra. All Na-Te bond lengths are 3.11 Å. Ga³⁺ is bonded to four equivalent Te²⁻ atoms to form GaTe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GaTe₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaTe₄ tetrahedra. All Ga-Te bond lengths are 2.63 Å. Te²⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ga³⁺ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing TeNa₂Ga₂ tetrahedra.
